public_rationale: The second half holds. In the October 2024 CNBC survey of tech leaders, only a quarter said Copilot was worth its cost and half said it was too soon to know. But the general public had not 'practically all' tried it. A nationally representative St. Louis Fed survey found that in August 2024 only about 40% of US adults aged 18 to 64 had used generative AI at all. Since he named no population, the result is mixed: the satisfaction point holds, and the 'practically everyone' point holds only for big businesses.
limitations: The population he meant is unstated, and the original LinkedIn post was not found.
The CNBC panel is small and not representative.
The Fed survey covers only US adults aged 18 to 64.
